# SigRepo 1.0.0
* Documentation: https://montilab.github.io/SigRepo/
* GitHub: https://github.com/montilab/SigRepo/
* `getSignature()` works for viewer accounts again. `createOmicSignature()`, which rebuilds each retrieved signature, re-checked the caller as an editor with INSERT, so a viewer (including the default guest handler) found the signature and then failed inside the loop; it now asks for SELECT as a viewer, like `getSignature()` itself (#260).
* Uni-directional signatures may omit scores: the four `add*SignatureSet()` functions no longer require a non-empty `score`, which is stored as NULL and comes back as NA. `addSignature()` now rolls back and errors if the feature step stored no rows, instead of returning a signature id for an empty signature. Needs OmicSignature >= 1.4.1, which keeps NA-score rows (#258, montilab/SigRepo_Server#89).
* `R/hypeR_examples.R`, a Shiny UI module left over from prototyping the server's Annotate tab, is removed from the package source along with its `.Rbuildignore` line. It was never built, exported or referenced (#248).
* `addUser()` and `updateUser()` now grant privileges on the database the connection is on instead of a hard-coded `sigrepo` schema, and `checkDBTable()` reads `SHOW TABLES` by position, so seeding and lookups work on a database with any name (#245, montilab/SigRepo_Server#130).
